summary: Master the art of property management with our Advanced Residential Property Management Course. Gain essential skills for success in the real estate industry.
lede: Residential property management training helps property teams coordinate leases, maintenance, finances, and compliance across residential portfolios. For managers and operations staff, it builds practical routines for reviewing rent rolls and cash flow, managing tenant lifecycles, and planning maintenance and vendor performance. Participants also practice preparing budgets, maintaining compliance and risk registers, and creating KPI-based portfolio reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already manage or support residential property operations and need sharper systems for leasing, maintenance, finance, and reporting.
prerequisites: To get the most from the course, bring experience with residential leases, tenant records, maintenance coordination, and basic property budgeting. A laptop with spreadsheet software is recommended for the budgeting, reporting, and dashboard exercises; sample templates and practice datasets are provided during training.
